title: Started Coding
shortDescription: Started learning programming independently through YouTube and online resources during the COVID-era learning period.
description: Started learning programming independently through YouTube and online resources during the COVID-era learning period. Most of the progress came from short experiments, repeated mistakes, and trying to understand how small pieces of code behaved before I knew the bigger picture.

media.alt: Developer workspace with code on a monitor
media.caption: A representative view of the kind of environment where the learning started

title: Git & GitHub
shortDescription: Learned Git and GitHub and created my first GitHub account.
description: Learned Git and GitHub and created my first GitHub account. That shift mattered because it turned coding into something I could track, revisit and improve instead of treating every project as a one-off experiment.

title: First Web Projects
shortDescription: Built early projects including a Flappy Bird game and a fee management system.
description: Built early projects including a Flappy Bird game and a fee management system. These were important because they pushed me beyond tutorials and into building complete small products with interfaces, logic and state that had to work together.

media.caption: One of the earliest complete browser games
A small utility project that introduced structured data handling

title: Built WebChat
shortDescription: Built an end-to-end web-based chat application.
description: Built an end-to-end web-based chat application. This was a step up in complexity because it needed a stronger focus on interaction design, persistence and the flow between different parts of a real app instead of just a static demo.

media.caption: The chat interface that pushed the work toward a full product feel

title: Learned Web Technologies & APIs
shortDescription: Expanded into web technologies, APIs, and integrating existing technologies into new systems.
description: Expanded into web technologies, APIs, and integrating existing technologies into new systems. At this stage I was learning how to connect features instead of just building isolated pages, which made it easier to think about request/response flows and reusable application structure.

media.caption: A visual stand-in for the shift toward APIs and connected systems

title: Founded PixelWeave
shortDescription: Started a software startup named PixelWeave and built multiple projects under it.
description: Started a software startup named PixelWeave and built multiple projects under it. This turned the work from personal experiments into a clear delivery vehicle for real client projects, with more attention on packaging, presentation and shipping complete outcomes.

media.caption: The startup identity that started carrying the client work

title: Backend Internship
shortDescription: Completed a three-month backend development internship and built multiple projects.
description: Completed a three-month backend development internship and built multiple projects. The work focused on backend fundamentals such as APIs, auth flows, file handling and data-heavy interactions, and it helped connect the learning phase to real project delivery.

highlights: Built backend-focused features across several small projects.
Practiced API structure, authentication and file handling.
Used public repositories to keep the work visible and easy to review.

title: Computer Science University
shortDescription: Started my university journey in Computer Science at UET Lahore, Pakistan.
description: Started my university journey in Computer Science at UET Lahore, Pakistan. I am currently pursuing my degree while staying active in university life and using the coursework to strengthen the foundations behind the projects I build outside class.

media.alt: UET Lahore campus or university screenshot
media.caption: The beginning of the formal CS path

title: Spikofest Programming Contest
shortDescription: Achieved top placement in both programming contests at the university event.
description: Achieved top placement in both programming contests at the university event. The result was especially meaningful because it came from a live competition setting where speed, correctness and calm problem-solving all mattered at the same time.

media.caption: The moment the placement was recognized
Contest certificates from the university event

highlights: Placed highly in both programming contests.
Validated competitive problem-solving under time pressure.
Added a milestone that sits alongside the project work.

title: Real Business Website
shortDescription: Built a production website for a real organization through PixelWeave.
description: Built a production website for a real organization through PixelWeave. The project pushed the work into a more production-oriented setting where polish, reliability and the ability to present a business properly all mattered.

title: Real Business Desktop Applications
shortDescription: Built multiple desktop applications for real businesses, including Elixis, a pharmacy management system.
description: Built multiple desktop applications for real businesses, including Elixis, a pharmacy management system. The production version is closed source, while a partial initial version may be publicly available. The work covers real operational screens such as inventory, sales and reporting, which is the kind of software that has to stay useful day after day.
